prisoners, including American citizens.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The testimony was published in 2020; it does not provide a 2023 preparedness.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.8","3B.9","5B.6","5B.7","6B.2","6B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The evidence concerns the period up to 2020, including the early COVID-19 response, supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The testimony stated that, unless el-Sisi made dramatic changes to a highly coercive and exclusionary approach to governance, economics, and politics, Egypt was unlikely to meet the needs and aspirations of its large, young population or become a stable and reliable regional partner.","question_ids":["2B.10","4B.10","5B.10","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"This is a 2020 expert assessment and is not direct evidence of 2023 conditions.","ruler_attribution":"The outcome."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Egyptian military and security institutions were described as taking increasing control of politics, text does not identify specific laws, appointments, contracts, or dates supporting each aspect of the claimed takeover."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi's Egypt was described as following Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates in regional policy, dissenters.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.3","5B.1","5B.3","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The source reports the position as of 2020, not specifically 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The update."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Egypt was reported to have supplied arms and ammunition to Haftar in violation of the UN arms embargo and evidence concerns Egypt's Libya policy before the article's September 2020 publication, not 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony attributes the policy to el-Sisi's Egypt.","limitations":["The base-use allegation is explicitly reported rather than presented as independently established in the supplied text."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Egypt's Libya policies were described as prolonging and exacerbating the civil war, creating greater space for Europe.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.5","2B.10","3B.7","8B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"This is a 2020 assessment of preceding events and does not establish 2023 effects.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony attributes the consequences to policies of el-Sisi's government.","limitations":["The passage does not quantify Egypt's causal contribution relative to other actors."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"El-Sisi's counterinsurgency campaign in Sinai was described as relying substantially on scorched-earth tactics, including bulldozing villages and displacing thousands of residents; Egyptian military losses continued regularly, although insurgents were largely kept from bringing the fight to mainland cities.","question_ids":["2B.4","2B.9","3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The assessment concerns the campaign as of 2020, not 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The testimony supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Egypt was described as remaining reliant on Israeli support for border control, despite border control support."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"The testimony raised concern that el-Sisi's intense repression and large numbers of political prisoners impact.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.6","3B.9","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"This is a reported concern as of 2020, not a 2023 finding.","ruler_attribution":"The concern relates to effect."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8ef48ffbda79bb6f","start_unit":8,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Egypt was described as committed to a nuclear-free Middle East and, for a period, a helpful partner in
